name: Esti Studio Inc.
website_meta_description: Esti Studio is a fashion global textile design agency. We provide prints, textile designs, embroidered, and knit artwork from our 15 renowned studios.

Esti Studio Inc. Shop online Our Design Studios Calendar Contact Us Esti Studio is a textile design agency and a home away from home for some of the most prestigious design studios from around the world. It was established in 1990 by Esti, a former textile designer, design director, and stylist for textile converters. Combining her passion of the art of print designs and fashion with her love of people, Esti opened her agency for textile design studios. Esti Studio caters to the fashion world, to the home furnishing market and paper product building a strong relationship with both the European studios and the East Coastal clientele. Today, Esti Studio is the largest textile design agency in New York. We are five sales associates devoted to servicing our clients as best as possible. We bring them the newest trends in prints, embroideries, and embellishments. Our studios work with the most influential companies in Europe to always bring the hottest trends for our clients.
